problems.quote: mediated by elongation factors Tu/EF‑1α and G/GTP
problems.problem: G/GTP is not an elongation factor; the translocation factor is EF-G (prokaryotes) or EF-2 (eukaryotes).
problems.correction: mediated by elongation factors Tu/EF-1α and EF-G/EF-2
problems.verifierReason: Original 'G/GTP' is not a factor name; correction correctly identifies translocation factors EF-G/EF-2.
